The only note on JOS.7.21 is a hebrew_gloss on 'Babylonish mantle' (Hebrew mantle of Shinar), which is unrelated to this lemma and is not a textual note. Nothing in the ASV distinguishes the readings, so both stand and the qere base fallback carries the projection.
